title: Backend Engineer – Python/Django
company: Cascade Revenue Management - An AIMA Group Company
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled
**Backend Engineer with strong expertise in Python and Django**

to join our engineering team. The role will focus on designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing scalable backend services and APIs.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Django, Django REST Framework, relational databases, API development, and cloud-based application environments. You will work closely with frontend engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders to build reliable and scalable software solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and services using
  **Python and Django**

  .
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs using
  **Django REST Framework (DRF)**

  .
* Design efficient and scalable backend architectures capable of handling large volumes of data and traffic.
* Develop, integrate, and maintain APIs supporting frontend and third-party applications.
* Optimize database queries, schemas, and performance across relational databases (
  **PostgreSQL/MySQL**

  ) and time-series data stores (
  **InfluxDB**

  ), with a focus on high-volume audit logging.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices, including
  **OAuth and JWT**

  where applicable.
* Develop integrations with external systems and services.
* Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability issues.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code.
* Develop and maintain automated unit and integration testing.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with frontend engineers, product managers, designers, and other technical teams.
* Contribute to
  **CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices**

  .
* Work with containerization technologies such as
  **Docker**

  and, where applicable, Kubernetes.
* Support applications deployed on cloud platforms such as
  **AWS, GCP, or Azure**

  .
* Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to continuous improvements in system reliability and performance.
* Stay current with relevant backend technologies and industry best practices.

**Requirements**

* **3+ years of professional experience**

  in backend development using Python, 5+ years in overall development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Django**

  and
  **Django REST Framework (DRF)**

  .
* Strong understanding of
  **Python programming**

  , object-oriented programming, and backend development principles.
* Experience developing and maintaining
  **RESTful APIs**

  .
* Good knowledge of
  **PostgreSQL and/or MySQL**

  .
* Understanding of database design, indexing, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Experience with authentication and authorization mechanisms such as
  **JWT and OAuth**

  .
* Understanding of software development lifecycle and engineering best practices.
* Experience with automated testing and debugging.
* Familiarity with
  **Git and version control systems**

  .
* Understanding of CI/CD concepts and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with
  **Docker**

  and containerized application environments.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as
  **AWS, GCP, or Azure**

  .
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

﻿

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with
  **GraphQL, WebSockets**

  , or event-driven architectures.
* Experience working with
  **microservices architecture**

  .
* Exposure to distributed systems and high-volume applications.
* Experience with Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of application security and secure coding practices.
* Experience with performance monitoring and application observability.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
* Operate and continuously improve the CARS/BI backend within the global Enterprise Data

Warehouse and Business Intelligence platform, ensuring system stability, continuous data
  
  
loading, and the timely delivery of business-critical reports.

warehouse structures — that internal reporting teams and global Data Management initiatives
  
  
depend on, and act as 1st and 2nd level support for internal customers such as SCM and
  
  
Sales.

or incorrect reporting, and add dedicated database and ETL capacity to the global BI team,
  
  
including support to the Data Center team on infrastructure-related issues.

delivery of business-critical reports.

* Collaborate with the Data Center team to resolve infrastructure-related issues affecting BI

availability.
  
  
Education and Experience

Technology, or a comparable technical field.
  
  
Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in Business Intelligence, data warehousing, or
  
  
database development, including hands-on SQL and ETL work in an enterprise environment.
  
  
Experience supporting business users in a global or multi-time-zone IT organization is an advantage.
  
  

* Knowledge about either BI platforms (e.g. IBM Cognos BI suite) or ETL tools (e.g. Informatica

PowerCenter)
  
  

* Database, data modeling and SQL (preferred Oracle PLSQL)
* Good analytical and communication skills
* Teamplayer
* English
* Strong hands-on experience with SQL (advanced level)
* Solid understanding of relational databases and data warehouse concepts
* Experience with ETL tools and database technologies (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, SAP BW,

Informatica or similar)
  
  

* Performance tuning and query optimization skills
* Structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused working style
* Good understanding of enterprise data flows (SAP/CARS is a plus)

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go)
description:
About the Role
 




 We're looking for a senior backend engineer who writes production Go and enjoys building reliable, distributed systems. You'll join a small, early engineering team and take ownership of core backend services, from design through to running them in production.
 





 This role sits close to the infrastructure: the services you build will orchestrate cloud resources, handle long\-running background work, and need to behave correctly when things fail. We value reliability and clear design over cleverness.
 




  






 What you'll do
 



* Design and build backend services and APIs in Go
* Build and maintain asynchronous job processing: queues, retries, idempotent operations and failure recovery
* Integrate with cloud provider APIs and third\-party services
* Design data models and write performant, safe PostgreSQL code
* Build secure, multi\-tenant REST APIs with authentication and role\-based access control
* Add metrics, structured logging and alerting to everything you ship
* Take part in architecture decisions, code reviews and a shared on\-call rotation



  






 What we are looking for
 





 Must have
 



* 5\+ years of backend engineering, with at least 3  years writing production Go
* Solid concurrency in Go: goroutines, channels, context cancellation and timeouts, and graceful shutdown
* Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, transactions, row locking, migrations and query tuning
* Experience building distributed or asynchronous systems: job queues, retries, idempotency and failure handling
* Comfort with Linux, networking basics (DNS, TLS, HTTP, TCP) and debugging on real servers
* REST API design, authentication (sessions, JWT, MFA) and multi\-tenant access control
* Docker and Kubernetes experience, as a user deploying services
* Writing tests, including integration tests against real dependencies



  






 Nice to have
 



* Linux containers and virtualisation internals
* Google Cloud Platform (GKE, IAM, VPC, Cloud SQL) and Terraform
* Workflow engines such as Temporal
* TLS/certificate automation, reverse proxies (nginx, Caddy)
* Storage systems, snapshots and backup/restore tooling
* Subscription billing integrations (e.g. Stripe)

* Design clean database schemas and write optimized queries.
